description: Top holders of a NEP-141 token on NEAR with each one's share of total supply, labelled as the token itself, an issuer treasury, a contract (pool, bridge, custodian) or a plain account, so neither a pool nor unissued stock is mistaken for a whale. Holder count, shares, and LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH concentration of plain accounts over circulating supply. Supply from the NEAR RPC, holders from NearBlocks.
